5 strange hobbies that make
your brain work like a genius

memorising poems

learn one short poem by heart every month. it trains your memory like a muscle, and having a few lines ready for the right moment makes you unforgettable at dinner.

mental maths at the shop

add up your shopping in your head before you reach the till. a few minutes of daily mental maths keeps your mind fast in a way calculators quietly took away from us.

mapping from memory

after visiting somewhere new, draw a rough map of it from memory. it trains your spatial memory, and you'll start noticing places far more carefully while you're there.

learning odd subjects

spend 5 minutes a day on a subject you'd never normally touch: geology, opera, ancient law. your brain grows fastest when it has to make sense of something unfamiliar.

playing strategy games

play one strategy board game a week with friends, like chess or go. thinking several moves ahead while reading other people is a workout no screen can fully replace.
